title: Slow Roads
description: An endless driving game with no traffic, no timer and no goal. The road, hills and scenery are generated as you go, so you can cruise for as long as you like. Runs straight in the browser with nothing to install.
how_to_play: Click begin, then steer with WASD. Press F to switch on autodrive and just watch the scenery. The hints shown at the start list the other keys.
